t: A cheap RISC-V Bluetooth chip with two USB ports for wireless keyboard gadgets.
steps: Buy a WeAct CH582F core board from AliExpress or ElectroPi, or the WCH CH582M-EVT board from LCSC.
Install the free Arduino IDE and add the ElectronicCats arduino-wch58x core.
Install the open wchisp tool for flashing over USB.
Hold the BOOT button while you plug in the USB-C cable.
Upload a Blink example and watch an LED on a spare pin.
Unplug and replug with BOOT held before each new upload.
Try a Bluetooth example from WCH's ch583 SDK next.
meta: Open Board. From $8.48. A few stores.
